title: serapias lingua subsp. stenopetala
intro: Serapias lingua subsp. stenopetala, commonly known as the tongue orchid, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the orchid family. It is a perennial plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of this plant include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Serapias lingua subsp. stenopetala include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
